s: Texas-style brisket and Michelin-recognised smoke on Charleston's Eastside
w: Pitmaster John Lewis brought Texas-style, all-wood barbecue to Charleston's Eastside -- brisket, beef ribs and sausage smoked low and slow, served on butcher paper without much ceremony. Recognised in the Michelin Guide, it's built a reputation as one of the strongest barbecue rooms in a city usually associated with Lowcountry cooking rather than smoke.
_facts: Located at 464 N Nassau St, Charleston, SC 29403, Eastside
Run by pitmaster John Lewis, known for Texas-style all-wood smoked barbecue
Part of a small chain with locations in Atlanta and Greenville
